run_chameleon_inference: run the ChameleonInferenceModel to generate text tokens from a prompt and decode them
create_chameleon_model: create a ChameleonInferenceModel with paths to the model, text tokenizer, and VQGAN config files
generate_tokens: generate tokens from a text prompt using the ChameleonInferenceModel generate method
decode_tokens_to_text: decode generated tokens back to readable text using the ChameleonInferenceModel decode_text method
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to load a Chameleon model and generate text from a prompt
